js: var btns=Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('[role=dialog] button')); window.__darkFind=btns.map(function(b){return (b.textContent||'').trim()}).filter(function(t){return t==='Dark'}).length; var d=btns.filter(function(b){return (b.textContent||'').trim()==='Dark'})[0]; window.__darkClickAt=Date.now(); if(d){d.click(); window.__clickResult='clicked';} else {window.__clickResult='missing';}
